requirements.statement: Implement exactly the eleven canonical primitive kinds with explicit schema identity/version, canonical identity, and orthogonal validity, knowledge, support, readiness, and lifecycle dimensions.
Provide deterministic UTF-8 canonical JSON and stable SHA-256 content digests independent of mapping insertion order, with strict unknown-field rejection for authoritative schemas.

Validate portable canonical identities, repository-relative path/resource identities, references, duplicate IDs, and provenance that distinguishes direct observation, normalization, derivation, and runtime observation without filesystem or external effects.
Keep existing P0/P1/P2 and lifecycle public behavior unchanged by exposing the model only as an isolated library with no default writer or consumer migration.
